timeline.evidenceText: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

definitions.full: H2153. Zilpah זלף (√ of following; Thes compare Aramaic זְלַף Pa`el drop, drip ; compare ; also Late Hebrew זִלּוּף sprinkling , dropping, pouring , a full bowl , etc.) זִלְמָּה proper name, feminine Leah's maid , one of Jacob's wives, mother of Gad and Asher Gen 29:24 ; 30:9-10 , 12 (all J), 35:26 ; 37:2 ; 46:18 (all P).
definitions.rootNote: ; from an unused root apparently meaning to trickle, as myrrh; fragrant dropping;
